_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): realtime WebSocket slice — room-based ConnectionManager + authenticated socket endpoint with echo/broadcast demo. Complements feature-sse (SSE = server-to-client only; WS = bidirectional).
name: feature-websocket
description: Realtime WebSocket: per-room ConnectionManager (connect/disconnect/broadcast, dead-socket cleanup) + authenticated /ws/{room} endpoint with token hook.

variables.name: app_name
variables.description: Python package name (kept for import symmetry with other features)

variables.name: ws_path
variables.description: WebSocket route prefix, e.g. '/ws' (clients connect to ws://host/ws/<room>?token=...)

notes: After applying: 1) app.include_router(router) in main.py — websocket routes include the same way as HTTP, 2) replace _validate_token's demo body with decode_token from feature-auth and raise WebSocketException(1008) on failure, 3) frontend: new WebSocket(`ws://host{{ ws_path }}/<room>?token=<jwt>`) — pair with comp-chat for a live chat UI, 4) single-replica only; add a Redis pub/sub adapter in ws_manager when you scale out. No extra deps (uses FastAPI/Starlette websockets support).
